title: Reject Broken Telemetry
story: Bad capsules must be quarantined before the exchange accepts them.
lesson: Validate types before values. bool is an int subclass, so use type(value) is int when the contract excludes booleans.
objective: Return sorted error names for missing or invalid fields: 'id' must be a nonempty str; 'seq' an int >=0 excluding bool; 'value' int/float excluding bool. Ignore extras.
hint: Use type() checks and combine missing and invalid cases into one error per field.
